packages.name: Osysharp.Agents
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents — an Osy# package. AI agents as typed classes: skills with a typed input and a checked, typed result; tools that are the app's own actions, run as the agent and never past the person it works for; a hard budget per piece of work; a receipt and a tamper-evident record of every step; a gate that says what it does alone, what it proposes to a person first and what it never does; a ladder of help — a more capable model first, then a person, whom the work waits for; corrections people make of its work, drawn into instructions that reach it only once a person has made them active, in numbered sets a piece of work records and an agent can be put back to; and handing typed pieces of its work on to other agents — several at once — each with its own receipt under the one that handed it on, done for the same person, never doing alone what any piece of work above it must propose, and spending out of what is left above it.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.HumanRequests
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.HumanRequests — an Osy# package. an agent's proposals and questions as requests in the work queue of the person they are for: the proposal shown as the exact call, why, and what the agent had looked at; approve, reject with a reason, or approve and let it do this alone from now on; the answer carried back to the waiting work; an inbox item handed to an agent and taken back; work an agent gave up on put to its sponsor; and the tree of a piece of agent work on its page — who is doing what, where each piece stands, whom it waits for and what it cost.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.Inspector
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.Inspector — an Osy# package. one page for a piece of an AI agent's work, for a person who was not there: what was asked, by whom, for whom and as which account; the brief and the result; what the agent may do alone and what it proposes; the instruction set it ran with and what has changed since; every step in order with models, reasons, arguments as a person reads them, answers, proposals and who decided, questions and answers, waits and how long; delegated work as a tree; cost per step and in all against its limit; whether the record's chain still checks; and what was erased, shown as erased. Read-only, filterable, and each step has a link.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.Management
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.Management — an Osy# package. the screens a person runs an app's AI agents from: every agent with who answers for it, what it does alone, proposes and never does, its skills, the specialists it hands work to, what it has spent of its limits, how often people corrected it, and Pause and Resume with the reason; all the agents' work, filtered by agent, state, person, time and what it was charged to, each piece with its tree, what it waits for, its steps and Stop; everybody the agents are waiting on, for how long; every standing rule with who gave it, how often it has been used and Take back; what was spent by agent, skill, person and charge against each limit, and what a limit stopped; and who may do what.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.Processes
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.Processes — an Osy# package. agents inside business processes: each piece of an agent's work given in a workflow's run is told on that run — given, waiting on a person, finished, failed, called off — in the state that gave it, and opens in place as the full inspector; the work's own page says which run of which process it is a step of; a run is listed from its first agent step with nothing written in the workflow; and a table of a run's agent work with what each cost.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.Teaching
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.Teaching — an Osy# package. the screens people teach an AI agent on: Correct this on a piece of its work — the result, a step, a proposal — with what was wrong, what right looks like and why, and an instruction proposed from it in the same breath; and an agent's Instructions page: what is waiting to be read, what is active and since when, who decided, what each was drawn from, how much work was sent it and how often it was still corrected, with Activate, Edit, Reject, Retire and Roll back for those the app admits.

packages.name: Osysharp.Agents.Testing
packages.description: Osysharp.Agents.Testing — an Osy# package. testing agents for free: a script of the model's answers turn by turn (tool calls, the result handed back, words, advice from a consulted model), and the trajectory, models and cost of a piece of work read back from its record; and a cast that scripts several agents at once, with the tree of what they handed on to each other read back.

packages.name: Osysharp.Assignments
packages.description: Osysharp.Assignments — an Osy# package. durable assignments: a piece of work somebody asked for, owned until its outcome is reached — completion by declared criteria (or a written exception), re-openable with its record; agent runs, processes, requests and handoffs attached to it; progress told apart from activity; waiting, blocked, overdue and stalled worked out with their reasons; linked and nested assignments; and what it has cost.

packages.name: Osysharp.Assignments.Agents
packages.description: Osysharp.Assignments.Agents — an Osy# package. an agent's work attached to the assignment it is for: attached under a key before the run starts, answered from its receipt when it had already finished, run again when it never reported back; its cost counted on the assignment, refused once the assignment's budget is spent; called off when the assignment is; work the agent hands on to other agents is attached to the same assignment, a piece each, and the whole is counted once.

packages.name: Osysharp.Assignments.Allocations
packages.description: Osysharp.Assignments.Allocations — an Osy# package. shared resources between assignments: a pool with a counted amount (stock, hours, money), claims that are held or refused so two assignments never hold the same unit, claims that wait their turn, what happens when there is less than was thought (the pool is overdrawn, each holder is told, the pool's keeper decides who gives way), and release when an assignment closes; with the pool's page and a panel on every assignment

packages.name: Osysharp.Assignments.WorkQueues
packages.description: Osysharp.Assignments.WorkQueues — an Osy# package. what an assignment asks of people: a request put for an assignment is a piece of its work and an item in the inbox of whoever it waits on; what an agent proposes or asks while working for the assignment is attached by itself; the answer closes the work, a reminder and a missed date are on the assignment's trail; the assignment's page lists who it is waiting on, and the inbox item says which assignment it is part of.

packages.name: Osysharp.Automations
packages.description: Osysharp.Automations — an Osy# package. rules that do an app's own work when something happens — a trigger from any event about the record or the hourly clock, conditions on the record's own fields as the rule's author may read them (and how long it has waited), and steps that are the app's own [Action] functions with the choices they offer; run in order, as the person who saved them under their own security, loop-protected, each fire recorded; the app's rules declared in code, copied by the team or a person to change them (restorable, lockable).

packages.name: Osysharp.BankId
packages.description: Osysharp.BankId — an Osy# package. Swedish BankID — auth and sign with animated QR or autostart, over mutual TLS.

packages.name: Osysharp.BarcodeScanner
packages.description: Osysharp.BarcodeScanner — an Osy# package. a live barcode + QR scanner: it owns the camera, decoding with ZXing.

packages.name: Osysharp.Carriers.PostNord
packages.description: Osysharp.Carriers.PostNord — an Osy# package. PostNord parcels — booking with a PDF label, track & trace, service points, and a delivery provider.

packages.name: Osysharp.Carriers.Sendcloud
packages.description: Osysharp.Carriers.Sendcloud — an Osy# package. Sendcloud — many European carriers behind one API: labels, customs, tracking, returns, pickups, and a delivery provider.

packages.name: Osysharp.Carriers.Shippo
packages.description: Osysharp.Carriers.Shippo — an Osy# package. Shippo — USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express behind one API: labels, customs, returns, tracking, and a delivery provider.

packages.name: Osysharp.Charts
packages.description: Osysharp.Charts — an Osy# package. charts in pure Osy#, no JavaScript: many mark types on one scale, plus pie and axes.

packages.name: Osysharp.ClassBookings
packages.description: Osysharp.ClassBookings — an Osy# package. bookable sessions with numbered places that are never overbooked — a first-come waiting list whose freed places are offered for a limited time (or given at once) on a durable clock, booking windows, late cancellation and no-shows heard as events for the app to charge, check-in, walk-ins and the register closing by itself, weekly series in the app's time zone with one-off changes, instructors, rooms and equipment that no two sessions hold at once, reminders before a session, app-defined booking rules, booking for the people one acts for — with a timetable, a my-bookings page and the register.

packages.name: Osysharp.Color
packages.description: Osysharp.Color — an Osy# package. colour maths — hex and OKLCH, WCAG contrast, readable-on, mixing, and palettes (light and dark) suggested from one base colour.

packages.name: Osysharp.Conversations
packages.description: Osysharp.Conversations — an Osy# package. one conversation across channels — a single ordered timeline of messages, notes and events per conversation, visibility per entry enforced by rules (internal never reaches a customer), channels as adapters (email, SMS), a chat widget for a page or as a launcher in its corner with the app's own help above the first message, unread chat replies mailed (or sent on whichever channel reaches the kind of contact point the app names) with a single-use continue link, parties proven by a mailed code and merged or unmerged, people copied in and taken off by the desk, a message split off into a conversation of its own (it moves, with its files and its mail thread), side conversations started beside one — mail to somebody outside or a thread inside the team, drawn as a card on its timeline that opens into its own thread, the other side never seeing the conversation it is beside, each customer answered in their own language with every message scrubbed of card numbers at rest, a redacted canonical copy in the shared memory corpus, files on messages — a pasted screenshot shown in place, a source file previewed with its lines coloured, a ZIP listed, every file a download readable exactly where its message is — and an erasure run that reaches every copy, recorded and run only as a privacy request's plan or a conversation's period says (Osysharp.Privacy.Conversations).

packages.name: Osysharp.Conversations.MachineTranslation
packages.description: Osysharp.Conversations.MachineTranslation — an Osy# package. the app's own model as the translator of its conversations — a copy of every customer message in the desk's language and every reply in each customer's, through the app's key, router and budget; a missing key a state the desk is told about, never a lost message.

packages.name: Osysharp.Conversations.Mail
packages.description: Osysharp.Conversations.Mail — an Osy# package. email as a channel for Osysharp.Conversations — replies through Osysharp.Mail's outbox, from the address the customer wrote to and threaded; a mail received continues its conversation; out-of-office replies and bounces recognised.

packages.name: Osysharp.Conversations.Sms
packages.description: Osysharp.Conversations.Sms — an Osy# package. text messages as a channel for Osysharp.Conversations — replies through Osysharp.Sms's outbox from the app's own number, a text received continues that number's latest conversation within a window, carrier delivery reports, and a refusal of an alphanumeric sender that could never be answered.

packages.name: Osysharp.Csv
packages.description: Osysharp.Csv — an Osy# package. CSV in and out — quoted fields, Excel's separators and byte-order mark, formula-safe cells.

packages.name: Osysharp.CustomFields
packages.description: Osysharp.CustomFields — an Osy# package. fields an app's admins add to its records without a release — text, numbers, yes or no, a choice, a date; required or optional; asked of outside people or kept for the team — on forms with conditions, every answer checked on the server and held to its kind on every write; each kind of record declares its own field and value types, so a value's security is its record's; with the question controls, the in-place editor for a record's fields, and the settings sections to define fields and forms.

packages.name: Osysharp.Diagrams
packages.description: Osysharp.Diagrams — an Osy# package. a node/edge canvas: a laid-out picture of a process with a run's path on it, or an editor — pan, zoom, drag, connect; nodes rendered by the app's own Osy#.

packages.name: Osysharp.Dns
packages.description: Osysharp.Dns — an Osy# package. DNS records an app writes — one record shape, a pluggable provider, add-a-value TXT semantics, and a provider that keeps records in the app's own table.

packages.name: Osysharp.Dns.Cloudflare
packages.description: Osysharp.Dns.Cloudflare — an Osy# package. Cloudflare DNS as an Osysharp.Dns provider — records by the v4 API, TXT values added and removed one at a time, never proxied.

packages.name: Osysharp.EmailTemplates
packages.description: Osysharp.EmailTemplates — an Osy# package. mail that looks designed — a layout with preview line, logo and footer, headings, text, buttons, pictures and receipt lines, in the app's own theme — and the mail blocks staff arrange in a mail's region.

packages.name: Osysharp.FortySixElks
packages.description: Osysharp.FortySixElks — an Osy# package. SMS through 46elks — one message or a fan-out, with delivery reports and a dry run.

packages.name: Osysharp.Guardianship
packages.description: Osysharp.Guardianship — an Osy# package. who acts for whom: a child added by their guardian as an account they cannot sign in to yet, a second guardian invited by address, standings (acts for them, kept informed, ended) that change by themselves when the child comes of age, consents the guardian gives on the child's behalf against versioned wording, emergency contacts and the people who may collect them, care notes for staff on site — and one policy, ActsForDependant, for an app's own rules.

packages.name: Osysharp.HumanRequests
packages.description: Osysharp.HumanRequests — an Osy# package. requests put to people — a question with typed options, an approval bound to the exact version approved, a request for information or a document — from a person, a process or an agent, with a deadline in business hours, reminders and escalation; answered in the app's work queue or, with no account, through a link that opens that one request; the answer comes back typed to whatever waits for it, however long that takes.

packages.name: Osysharp.HumanRequests.Processes
packages.description: Osysharp.HumanRequests.Processes — an Osy# package. people inside business processes: each request a workflow's run puts to a person — a question, an approval, a form, a link sent to somebody outside — is told on that run in the state that put it: who was asked, that its date passed and whom it went on to, who answered and after how long, or that nobody did; and each line opens the request in place.

packages.name: Osysharp.Identity
packages.description: Osysharp.Identity — an Osy# package. who signs in, and which of the app's roles each person holds — the base every people-aware kit builds on.

packages.name: Osysharp.IncidentReports
packages.description: Osysharp.IncidentReports — an Osy# package. confidential incident reports — injuries, near misses, damage, concerns — in categories and severities the app defines, with the people involved and witnesses (accounts or just names), their statements, injuries and treatment, photos and files, a review that classifies the report, records the cause and sets corrective actions with owners and due dates, a close that waits for those actions, notices to the people who must be told (a child's guardians) with their acknowledgement, a deadline for reporting to an authority watched on a durable clock, a register with a CSV export — and a reporter's page, a review desk, the register and a setup page.

packages.name: Osysharp.IncidentReports.Guardianship
packages.description: Osysharp.IncidentReports.Guardianship — an Osy# package. the guardians Osysharp.Guardianship links are who Osysharp.IncidentReports tells when somebody they look after is named in an incident — offered on the review desk, told in one call, and their acknowledgement kept.

packages.name: Osysharp.Invitations
packages.description: Osysharp.Invitations — an Osy# package. invite a person by address with their role (and organisation) fixed when it is sent — mailed, reminded, expiring, revocable and resendable as a durable run; answered only by the invited address: a newcomer through a single-use mailed link, an existing account only once fully signed in (its second step included) and with that address proven.

packages.name: Osysharp.KnowledgeBase
packages.description: Osysharp.KnowledgeBase — an Osy# package. a knowledge base and its public help centre — markdown articles in categories and sections, drafts, numbered versions, review before publishing (nobody publishes their own words while review is on), a version per language with the original as fallback, team-only articles that never reach a customer or a search, search and suggestions as a person types — in each version's own language, so an inflected word finds its other forms, and by meaning once the app has an embedder — structured data and a sitemap for search engines, and the desk to write, review and arrange it all.

packages.name: Osysharp.Llm
packages.description: Osysharp.Llm — an Osy# package. calling a model: the provider and router contracts, the call path (route, reserve, call, fall back, meter), a price book and budgets with hard limits, typed extraction and typed decisions, and a scripted model for tests.

packages.name: Osysharp.LlmRouter
packages.description: Osysharp.LlmRouter — an Osy# package. a cost-tiered model router: hard capability filters, quality floors per task kind and per step, a cost ceiling a short budget steps down under, then cheapest-admissible — in an order that is the fallback order.

packages.name: Osysharp.LoadingOrbs
packages.description: Osysharp.LoadingOrbs — an Osy# package. thinking orbs for waiting states — nine animated dotted spheres (searching, composing, weaving…) in pure Osy#, themed by tokens.

packages.name: Osysharp.Localization
packages.description: Osysharp.Localization — an Osy# package. a translator's desk: untranslated and stale words and data in every language, and overrides that survive a recompile.

packages.name: Osysharp.MachineTranslation
packages.description: Osysharp.MachineTranslation — an Osy# package. language detection that works offline (scripts, and the commonest words of twelve European languages) and translation through the app's own model — glossary terms kept as written, a missing key a state rather than an error.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail — an Osy# package. mail an app sends — one message shape, a pluggable sender, an outbox that delivers after the commit and holds mail when there is no sender; connected mailboxes it sends from (and, with Osysharp.Mail.Receiving, reads); MIME parsing and reply extraction.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail.Gmail
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail.Gmail — an Osy# package. a Gmail / Google Workspace inbox as a mailbox for Osysharp.Mail — new mail pushed through Cloud Pub/Sub (polled without), replies sent from it, threaded.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail.Imap
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail.Imap — an Osy# package. any IMAP mailbox as a mailbox for Osysharp.Mail — new mail read over IMAP, replies sent over SMTP, threaded.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail.Microsoft365
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail.Microsoft365 — an Osy# package. a Microsoft 365 mailbox as a mailbox for Osysharp.Mail — new mail polled through Graph, replies sent from it, threaded.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail.Receiving
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail.Receiving — an Osy# package. watched mailboxes — new mail pushed (Gmail via Pub/Sub, Microsoft 365 via Graph) with a half-hourly safety net, or polled; each message kept once with its original, handed to the app's receiver after the commit, retried, failed with its reason, erasable by sender; and the settings page for whoever manages them.

packages.name: Osysharp.Mail.Resend
packages.description: Osysharp.Mail.Resend — an Osy# package. Resend as a sender for Osysharp.Mail — threading headers and attachments included.

packages.name: Osysharp.MailingLists
packages.description: Osysharp.MailingLists — an Osy# package. mailing lists — double opt-in, consent recorded word for word, signed unsubscribe and preferences, suppression of bounces and complaints, export and erasure.

packages.name: Osysharp.MarkdownEditor
packages.description: Osysharp.MarkdownEditor — an Osy# package. a rich EDITOR over a `Markdown` property: rich and source modes, tables, maths.

packages.name: Osysharp.Memberships
packages.description: Osysharp.Memberships — an Osy# package. memberships and passes — day tickets, monthly and yearly memberships, cards of N visits (a pack of Osysharp.PrepaidCredits), starting on a date or on the first visit; admission that uses a visit, never goes below zero and says plainly why somebody may not enter; pauses that move the end date, extension, renewal (by hand or by the app's payment) and the notice before it ends, transfer, family members on one membership, and its unused value in money — every change and every attempt to enter recorded with who and why — with a my-memberships page, a desk page and a plans page.

packages.name: Osysharp.Memory.Testing
packages.description: Osysharp.Memory.Testing — an Osy# package. a deterministic, offline embedder for tests — a hashed bag of words — so a suite can assert what Memory.Search and [Searchable(Memory)] find without a model.

packages.name: Osysharp.MicrosoftGraph
packages.description: Osysharp.MicrosoftGraph — an Osy# package. Microsoft 365 through Graph — mail, calendar and files, as the signed-in user or as the app.

packages.name: Osysharp.Models.Anthropic
packages.description: Osysharp.Models.Anthropic — an Osy# package. the Anthropic Messages API as a model provider for Osysharp.Llm — complete and stream, with prompt caching, tool choice and structured output.

packages.name: Osysharp.Models.Gemini
packages.description: Osysharp.Models.Gemini — an Osy# package. the Google Gemini API as a model provider for Osysharp.Llm — complete and stream, tools included.

packages.name: Osysharp.Models.OpenAi
packages.description: Osysharp.Models.OpenAi — an Osy# package. the OpenAI Chat Completions API as a model provider for Osysharp.Llm — and any endpoint that speaks its wire.

packages.name: Osysharp.Notifications
packages.description: Osysharp.Notifications — an Osy# package. telling a person something needs them — a bell with a live count and a list (read and unread, mark all read), a daily mail digest of what they have not seen or a mention mailed at once (their own choice, in their own language), delivered durably after the commit, deduplicated while unread, and never about a record the recipient may not read under their own security.

packages.name: Osysharp.OfferSales
packages.description: Osysharp.OfferSales — an Osy# package. sell a few simple offers — a ticket, a pass, a pack, a membership — online through any payment provider, by transfer or pay-at-the-desk marked received, or across a counter (cash, a card terminal, a reader or a QR code), for the buyer or somebody they buy for; prices, sale windows, limited places and a per-person limit; each purchase recorded with a receipt number, held while it is paid and lapsing when it is not; paid announced exactly once, refunds whole or in part announced once each; the day's takings by channel and method and a CSV — with an offers page, a buyer's purchases, a counter and an offers desk.

packages.name: Osysharp.OfferSales.Memberships
packages.description: Osysharp.OfferSales.Memberships — an Osy# package. an Osysharp.Memberships plan as an Osysharp.OfferSales offer — sold to whoever it was bought for once it is paid, at what was paid, and ended when it is refunded in full.

packages.name: Osysharp.OfferSales.PrepaidCredits
packages.description: Osysharp.OfferSales.PrepaidCredits — an Osy# package. a pack of Osysharp.PrepaidCredits as an Osysharp.OfferSales offer — credits, a scope and a validity — granted to whoever it was bought for once it is paid, and voided when it is refunded in full.

packages.name: Osysharp.Organizations
packages.description: Osysharp.Organizations — an Osy# package. customer companies and internal teams: who belongs to which, roles held within one organisation (the app's own roles, scoped), mail domains that put a newcomer with a PROVEN address in the right company, taking a person out (or leaving) — recorded, mailed, the last owner kept — and membership rows that remember their source and external id so single sign-on and SCIM can keep them in step.

packages.name: Osysharp.Organizations.ServicePlans
packages.description: Osysharp.Organizations.ServicePlans — an Osy# package. the service each customer organisation gets — its tier, its entitlements (by tier or its own contract, for a period), its account team (owner, pod, backup) and its VIP people — set by the app's organisation managers alone, and carried for support and sales kits to route and promise by; with a settings page for the tiers.

packages.name: Osysharp.PageBuilder
packages.description: Osysharp.PageBuilder — an Osy# package. the page desk: arrange each Region's blocks with generated forms and a live preview, site versions on a schedule, and a staff preview of the whole site.

packages.name: Osysharp.Payments
packages.description: Osysharp.Payments — an Osy# package. the payment-provider contract — start, confirm, capture, refund, cancel and webhook events — plus manual payment.

packages.name: Osysharp.Payments.Klarna
packages.description: Osysharp.Payments.Klarna — an Osy# package. Klarna payments — a session, an order, and the capture/refund half that comes after.

packages.name: Osysharp.Payments.Stripe
packages.description: Osysharp.Payments.Stripe — an Osy# package. card payments through Stripe — payment intents, checkout sessions, customers, refunds, verified webhooks, and a payments-contract provider.

packages.name: Osysharp.Payments.Swish
packages.description: Osysharp.Payments.Swish — an Osy# package. Swish payments — a request to the payer's phone or a QR code, status asked of Swish over mutual TLS, and refunds.

packages.name: Osysharp.PdfViewer
packages.description: Osysharp.PdfViewer — an Osy# package. a paged PDF reader over a `FileAsset`, canvas-rendered, with a real text layer.

packages.name: Osysharp.PdfWriter
packages.description: Osysharp.PdfWriter — an Osy# package. write a PDF — text in Helvetica, rules and pages — for receipts, invoices and slips.

packages.name: Osysharp.PrepaidCredits
packages.description: Osysharp.PrepaidCredits — an Osy# package. prepaid uses: packs of credits granted to a person (a class pack, a ten-visit card, desk-hours), optionally expiring and scoped, spent several at a time from the pack that expires first, never below zero, idempotent per reference, refundable, for the holder or somebody they pay for; staff adjust, extend, void and move credits with a reason; expiry and low-balance notices; a statement the holder reads; and the value still owed — with a my-credits page and a desk page.

packages.name: Osysharp.Presence
packages.description: Osysharp.Presence — an Osy# package. who else is on a record, live — a presence topic addressed by any record's id, staff-only by the app's own rule, each seat stamped with who by the platform and carrying an activity (viewing, replying, assigning) but never content; a seats strip for the record's header; and the 'moved first' sentence that turns a concurrency refusal into who changed which fields and when.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy — an Osy# package. what the app holds about a person and why it may keep it — a versioned holder contract every kit implements, categories with a retention basis and a period the tenant sets within declared limits (with jurisdiction presets and a fiscal-year-aware end date), requests that plan erase / keep restricted until a date / blocked per category and run as a workflow, a response that says what was erased and what was kept and why, an access and portability export, and a daily purge.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Agents
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Agents — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Agents — what the app's AI agents did for a person and about a person: found by the account it was for and by what the app marked it as about, in their copy of their data, kept out of use on request, erased on request while every record's hash chain still verifies, its content gone after a month and the record after seven for everybody, with legal holds honoured.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Assignments
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Assignments — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Assignments — the people on an assignment (found by account) and the person an assignment is about (found by what the app marked): in their copy of their data, kept out of use on request, and erased on request while the assignment, its criteria and how it ended stay — a colleague reads as somebody no longer here, the person it was about as a former customer; an assignment about somebody loses its words two years after it closed, with legal holds honoured.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.ClassBookings
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.ClassBookings — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.ClassBookings — the places a person booked or waited for, their attendance, late cancellations and no-shows: counted, in their copy of their data, and erased when they ask, a place they still held passing to the next person waiting.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Conversations
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Conversations — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Conversations — complaints kept RESTRICTED for legal claims — read only for a claim, every read logged — while the rest of a person's conversations, their contact points and the redacted copies are erased on request, a daily purge that ends every conversation's period, the app's own say on which conversations concern a claim, and a person with no account proving their address to ask for themselves.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Guardianship
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Guardianship — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Guardianship — who looks after a person and whom they look after, their date of birth and care notes (special-category data), the consents answered for them, their emergency contacts and the invitations to their address: counted, in their copy of their data, and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.HumanRequests
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.HumanRequests — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.HumanRequests — the requests put to a person (by account, or by the address a link was sent to) and the requests marked as about them: in their copy of their data with what they were asked and answered, kept out of use, and erased when they ask — the request left standing with how it ended, and a process run that told it told again without them

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.IncidentReports
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.IncidentReports — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.IncidentReports — the reports a person filed, the reports naming them with their injury, care and statement, and what they were told about an incident: special-category data kept on a legal obligation, counted, in their copy of their data, and erased from the record once its period ends.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.KnowledgeBase
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.KnowledgeBase — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.KnowledgeBase — the articles and versions a person wrote or published and the review steps they took, found by their account, in their copy of their data, their review notes kept restricted on request, and their name taken off everything when they ask to be erased while the articles stay.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Llm
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Llm — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Llm's meter — the AI model calls made for a person: found by their account, in their copy of their data, kept out of use on request, taken off the meter when they ask to be erased or after thirteen months while what the calls cost stays counted, with legal holds honoured.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.MailReceiving
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.MailReceiving — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Mail.Receiving — the mail a person sent to the app's watched mailboxes, as it arrived, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Memberships
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Memberships — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Memberships — a person's memberships, who else they let in, every change and every visit, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Notifications
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Notifications — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Notifications — a person's notifications and their preferences, found by their account, in their copy of their data, kept restricted on request and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.OfferSales
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.OfferSales — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.OfferSales — the purchases a person made or had made for them, how they were paid and what was refunded: kept on the books' legal obligation, counted, in their copy of their data, and erased when that ends.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.PrepaidCredits
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.PrepaidCredits — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.PrepaidCredits — a person's packs, what they used them for and every change to them, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Qualifications
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Qualifications — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Qualifications — the qualifications a person holds, what they signed and on which text, and the evidence files, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.SatisfactionSurveys
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.SatisfactionSurveys — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.SatisfactionSurveys — a person's questions and answers about how it went, found by their account or a proven address, in their copy of their data, kept restricted on request and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.ShiftScheduling
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.ShiftScheduling — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.ShiftScheduling — a person's shifts, time off, the hours they are not free and their cover requests, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.Sms
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.Sms — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.Sms — the texts the app sent a person, found by their number, in their copy of their data and erased when they ask.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.UserAccounts
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.UserAccounts — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's part for Osysharp.UserAccounts — the step-up for self-service requests (a code to the account's own address, typed back, spent once by the request's run), and accounts made for somebody who never signs in: in their guardian's copy of their data, and erased with the person they were made for.

packages.name: Osysharp.Privacy.WorkRepositories
packages.description: Osysharp.Privacy.WorkRepositories — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Privacy's holder for Osysharp.WorkRepositories — the items of an assignment's repository that are about a person (found by what the app marked, or by the assignment they belong to) and what a person contributed (found by account): in their copy of their data, kept out of use on request, erased on request while each item keeps its place in the record, and each kind erased for everybody when its own period ends — the app's rule per kind as a category the tenant can change, with legal holds honoured.

packages.name: Osysharp.Processes
packages.description: Osysharp.Processes — an Osy# package. business processes as workflows the app names: every run listed and searched by process, state, age and what is stuck; one run drawn on a canvas with where it is and the path it took; each state it was in and for how long, what happened there in order — moves, claims, reminders, deadlines, the process's own notes and the steps other kits record; what the run has spent on models against the limit set for each run; and the runs it started.

packages.name: Osysharp.Qualifications
packages.description: Osysharp.Qualifications — an Osy# package. qualifications a person holds — licences, certificates, inductions, checks and signed waivers — of kinds with a validity in months (or none), recorded by staff or submitted with evidence for verification, a waiver signed on the exact text version the person was shown (by them, or by whoever acts for them), revocation and rejection with the reason, a renewal notice before each lapses and word when it does, and one call answering whether somebody holds what is needed now and why not — with a person's own page, a staff page of what lapses soon and what waits for verification, and a kinds page with the waiver texts.

packages.name: Osysharp.RecordTimeline
packages.description: Osysharp.RecordTimeline — an Osy# package. a record's timeline, from the events the app and its kits raise — one line per event on the record it is about and on each record it rolls up to, said in the reader's words from the event's own sentence, shown only to somebody who may read the record, kept for a declared time; one component to place it on a record's page.

packages.name: Osysharp.ReplyComposer
packages.description: Osysharp.ReplyComposer — an Osy# package. where a person writes a reply to any record — saved replies with typed placeholders filled from the record (an unknown key refused when saved, an unfillable one refused at send), macros that stage the app's own verbs and run them with the send, markdown formatting with a bar and keys that act on the selection, drafts saved per record and per author that survive a reload (and a seam for a draft prepared by someone else), the writer's signature, files pasted, dropped or picked, and 'send and set…' as the app's choice.

packages.name: Osysharp.Reports
packages.description: Osysharp.Reports — an Osy# package. reports a team builds for itself — start from one thing the app keeps, pick fields by following its relations, group, measure (counts, totals, averages, medians and percentiles) and filter, all computed in the database as the reader may read it — read as figures, a table and a chart, exported as CSV, saved and shared by name.

packages.name: Osysharp.Resend
packages.description: Osysharp.Resend — an Osy# package. transactional email through Resend — one send or a batch, text and HTML, replies and attachments.

packages.name: Osysharp.S3
packages.description: Osysharp.S3 — an Osy# package. an app.BlobStore for S3-compatible object storage — AWS S3 and Cloudflare R2 — signed with SigV4.

packages.name: Osysharp.SatisfactionSurveys
packages.description: Osysharp.SatisfactionSurveys — an Osy# package. asking the person a piece of work served how it went — one good-or-bad answer and an optional comment per subject and person (held by the database), answered from a mail link with no account or signed in on the app's page, changeable for a while, applied durably after the commit, and read back as a summary: answered, good, week by week, recent comments.

packages.name: Osysharp.Seo
packages.description: Osysharp.Seo — an Osy# package. schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) for a page's head — products, offers, articles, breadcrumbs, organizations.

packages.name: Osysharp.ShiftScheduling
packages.description: Osysharp.ShiftScheduling — an Osy# package. a staff rota — shifts with a number of places, positions and what working one requires (answered by the app, or a qualifications kit), drafts published in one go, places a manager assigns or a worker claims (never over-filled, one place a shift, no overlaps, approved time off, weekly unavailability and an hours cap respected, the app's own rules asked), cover requests and swaps with approval, copying a week, hours per person and period, and a durable reminder before every shift — with a worker's my-shifts page, a manager's week and a requests page.

packages.name: Osysharp.ShiftScheduling.Qualifications
packages.description: Osysharp.ShiftScheduling.Qualifications — an Osy# package. a rota position's requirements answered by Osysharp.Qualifications — nobody is put on a shift needing a qualification they do not hold in force that day, and the refusal says why in the qualifications kit's words.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shipping
packages.description: Osysharp.Shipping — an Osy# package. the delivery contract — quote, ship, track and carrier events — plus flat-rate delivery and collection.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop — an Osy# package. an online shop's backend — catalogue, bag, orders, pluggable payment and delivery providers, returns, mail and the staff desk — with its customers and staff signing in through Osysharp.UserAccounts.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.AgeCheck.BankId
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.AgeCheck.BankId — an Osy# package. Age verification with Swedish BankID — the shop's AgeVerifier, over mutual TLS.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Bookkeeping
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Bookkeeping — an Osy# package. a shop's books — SIE 4, CSV and the VAT report per rate — from its invoices and credit notes.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Discounts
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Discounts — an Osy# package. discount codes for the shop — percent, amount or free delivery, with limits and dates.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.ExchangeRates
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.ExchangeRates — an Osy# package. the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, for showing a visitor prices in their own currency.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Atelier
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Atelier — an Osy# package. a shop look — the gallery wall: white, one light grotesk, full-bleed photographs, hairlines, an oxblood accent.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Boutique
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Boutique — an Osy# package. a shop look — the boutique: powder blue, navy, a soft serif, round corners, a tomato accent and a sliding bag.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Drop
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Drop — an Osy# package. a shop look — the drop: black, a poster face in capitals, a ticker, mono labels, a signal-orange accent.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Fitting
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Fitting — an Osy# package. a shop look — the fitting room: dark chocolate, Young Serif in italic, the piece pinned to half the screen, amber.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Index
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Index — an Osy# package. a shop look — the index: grey, black Geist, mono prices, the shelf tree always in view, an acid-lime accent.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Kiosk
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Kiosk — an Osy# package. a shop look — the kiosk: lilac-grey, one light grotesk, the find full-bleed like a magazine cover, an emerald accent.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Loud
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Loud — an Osy# package. a shop look — loud: hot yellow, black poster type in capitals, a ticker, an electric-blue accent.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Rail
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Rail — an Osy# package. a shop look — the rail: a bottle-green wall, a big tight grotesk, finds pinned at an angle, a price-tag yellow.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Studio
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Studio — an Osy# package. a shop look — the showroom: aubergine on white, an italic serif, a pinned photograph that follows the page, hot pink.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Swap
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Looks.Swap — an Osy# package. a shop look — the swap sheet: white, a condensed grotesk and mono lot labels, the shelves in a column, signal red.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Reviews
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Reviews — an Osy# package. product reviews for the shop — verified buyers only, moderated by staff, averaged for search engines.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.Subscriptions
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.Subscriptions — an Osy# package. subscriptions for the shop — plans and add-ons per interval, entitlements, renewals, prorated changes.

packages.name: Osysharp.Shop.VatNumbers
packages.description: Osysharp.Shop.VatNumbers — an Osy# package. EU VAT-number checks against VIES — the shop's reverse-charge check.

packages.name: Osysharp.Site.Looks
packages.description: Osysharp.Site.Looks — an Osy# package. the general site contract for looks — hero, picture with words, quote, opening hours, address, sign-up, gallery, announcement, footer — as block TYPES each look draws in its own design.

packages.name: Osysharp.Sms
packages.description: Osysharp.Sms — an Osy# package. text messages an app sends — one message shape, a pluggable sender, an outbox that delivers after the commit and holds messages when there is no sender.

packages.name: Osysharp.Sms.FortySixElks
packages.description: Osysharp.Sms.FortySixElks — an Osy# package. 46elks as a sender for Osysharp.Sms — Nordic alphanumeric senders, EU-only handling, and a dry run for staging.

packages.name: Osysharp.Stemming
packages.description: Osysharp.Stemming — an Osy# package. words in their base form for search — Snowball stemmers for English, Swedish, Danish and Norwegian and a light Arabic stemmer, so an inflected query finds the other forms of its words; any other language matched word for word.

packages.name: Osysharp.TimeZone
packages.description: Osysharp.TimeZone — an Osy# package. the app's clock — the time zone its days start in and the day its week starts, picked by staff from the app's declared zones on one settings page and read by every kit that counts in days.

packages.name: Osysharp.Ui
packages.description: Osysharp.Ui — an Osy# package. the general application vocabulary: buttons, fields, dialogs, the data grid, and the app shell.

packages.name: Osysharp.Ui.Looks
packages.description: Osysharp.Ui.Looks — an Osy# package. five looks for apps on the UI kit — Ledger, Relay, Civic, Studio, Signal — each a theme an app derives from and makes its own.

packages.name: Osysharp.UserAccounts
packages.description: Osysharp.UserAccounts — an Osy# package. sign-in (password, or a provider such as Google or GitHub, linked from the account page), sign-up, password reset and change, verified address change (one the desk can start, confirmed from the new address) and verification, an address proven by a mailed link or code, two-step sign-in with an authenticator app and recovery codes, passkeys (several per account, to sign in with no password and no code, and to turn password sign-in off), a phone number proven by a texted code (to sign in with, or as an optional second step), and accounts made for somebody who never signs in (a child, a walk-in) by whoever the app names, given an address later — with pages — on Osysharp.Identity. Staff are given their roles with Osysharp.UserManagement.

packages.name: Osysharp.UserManagement
packages.description: Osysharp.UserManagement — an Osy# package. the user manager: a searchable people list (roles, two-step sign-in, last sign-in, sessions), and audited access changes — grant and revoke the app's roles, deactivate and reactivate, reset a lost second factor, sign out everywhere, and the same within an organisation; API keys issued once and revoked at once, and integrations — programs that work under their own name with keys and a role and can never sign in — each one a record of who changed whose access, when and why, made only by the app's people managers.

packages.name: Osysharp.Warehouses.Databricks
packages.description: Osysharp.Warehouses.Databricks — an Osy# package. Databricks as a data source and an export destination: entities read from a SQL warehouse, and changes merged into its tables.

packages.name: Osysharp.Warehouses.Snowflake
packages.description: Osysharp.Warehouses.Snowflake — an Osy# package. Snowflake as a data source and an export destination: entities read from a warehouse, and changes merged into its tables.

packages.name: Osysharp.WebAnalytics
packages.description: Osysharp.WebAnalytics — an Osy# package. web analytics — Plausible or Google Analytics 4: page views, e-commerce events, and consent before GA4 tracks.

packages.name: Osysharp.Webhooks
packages.description: Osysharp.Webhooks — an Osy# package. outbound webhooks — an administrator subscribes an endpoint to any of the events the app and its kits raise about a record; each one is sent as a JSON document signed the Standard Webhooks way under a secret shown once and kept sealed, delivered durably after the commit with doubling retries, given up on in the end and the subscription paused when it keeps failing, every attempt in a delivery log whose documents are removed after a short declared retention; only what the subscription's maker may read is ever sent; a settings page to add, test, pause, roll the secret of and remove subscriptions and to send a failed delivery again.

packages.name: Osysharp.WorkQueues
packages.description: Osysharp.WorkQueues — an Osy# package. work queues, who holds what, and the service levels promised on it, over any item an app derives from WorkItem — and typed links between items, of kinds the app declares — with the screens a team works it from.

packages.name: Osysharp.WorkQueues.Notifications
packages.description: Osysharp.WorkQueues.Notifications — an Osy# package. the inbox's people told in their bell — an item offered to them, work handed to them while its holder is away, a promise at risk or missed on what they hold, and a queue's leads when nobody picks an item up — in their own words and language, and never about an item they may not read; the leads are whoever the app's LeadsInbox policy says.

packages.name: Osysharp.WorkQueues.Reports
packages.description: Osysharp.WorkQueues.Reports — an Osy# package. Osysharp.Reports sources for Osysharp.WorkQueues — arrived, done, first reply and time to done (median and slowest tenth), open now, and promises kept, by agent, queue, channel, organization, tier and priority.

packages.name: Osysharp.WorkRepositories
packages.description: Osysharp.WorkRepositories — an Osy# package. the shared repository of an assignment: evidence, correspondence, findings, documents, proposals, decisions and deliverables as typed items — each version kept with who or what added it and from what source, concurrent contributions kept side by side, standings and visible disagreements, access and retention per kind, items opened one by one to somebody who is not on the assignment.

packages.name: Osysharp.WorkRepositories.Agents
packages.description: Osysharp.WorkRepositories.Agents — an Osy# package. an agent's findings as repository items: tools that record evidence, findings, correspondence and proposals as the agent, for whoever asked, with their source and the piece of work they were written in; tools that list and read items by reference; and the result of every piece of agent work attached to an assignment filed as an unverified finding with its receipt.
